description: TATSAJ crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: 4(Na1 1+),C22 H30 N4 Nd2 O20 4-,13(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Nd1 (Nd) has 7 O neighbors; Nd1A (Nd) has 7 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 1 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.931-3.931 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 112.50-112.50°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula Na4[{Nd(H2O)}2(μ2-dptaO)2]·13H2O (C22H56N4Na4Nd2O33). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 1 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula). Article name explicitly identifies I(II).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
